business_overview.one_sentence: Tristate Holdings operates garment manufacturing and brands business, including C.P. Company and licensed brands such as Nautica, Spyder and Reebok.

segments.name: Garment manufacturing
segments.source: Annual Report 2023 Note 4 Revenue and Segment Reporting, pages 78-79

segments.name: Brands business
segments.source: Annual Report 2023 Note 4 Revenue and Segment Reporting, pages 78-79

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognised when control of garments or retail goods is transferred to customers; manufacturing customers generally receive 45-90 day credit terms.
business_notes: Brands business revenue reached HK$2,283 million in 2023 and garment manufacturing revenue was HK$1,933 million.

Management disclosed that C.P. Company and garment manufacturing continued to contribute profits and cash flow, while licensed brands in China reduced losses but Reebok remained loss-making during rebuilding.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow exceeds reported parent net profit, but 2023 cash flow benefited from inventory reduction and loss reduction in licensed brands. Brands business remains partly loss-making and requires retail leases, inventory and licence fee commitments.

gaps: The annual report discloses cash by currency but not by parent company versus each subsidiary; detachable cash uses conservative group-level haircuts.
The annual report does not precisely separate maintenance capex from growth capex; owner earnback uses cash capex and profit haircut rather than adding back all non-cash items.
Necessary operating cash is estimated from sales scale, working capital seasonality, supplier credit and retail/manufacturing operating needs.
